Liberty 250

Welcome, one and all…

 

Whether you’re a patriot at heart, a leader in motion, or simply someone who believes that America’s best days aren’t behind us — thank you for your presence.

​

This site exists for one simple reason: to reconnect people with the values that make liberty worth living. It’s a place for reflection, peaceful action, and lovingly building something that lasts.

Details about Liberty 250, a national movement launched in honor of America’s Semiquincentennial (250th birthday) celebrating timeless traits that bring us together under one flag.

​

This isn’t a partisan project. It’s a personal one. Freedom—true freedom—applies to all, transcending gender, race, religion, social class, and creed.

​

So, whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and however you found this gathering, we’re overjoyed you’re making our movement all the more exceptional…

Honor the Past // Live in the Future

Today, we stand at a crossroads. “The United TRAITS of America” are alive and well, but in recent years, we’ve allowed the powers that be to divide us — by way of identity politics, manufactured spin, and the constant churn of crisis.

 

Liberty 250 was founded to help refocus on what we share.

 

In our schools. In our businesses. In our communities. In ourselves.

 

Through books, keynotes, civic initiatives, and nationwide assemblies, Liberty 250 inspires individuals and organizations to lead with clarity, grit, and conviction. It’s a platform for personal transformation and, too, for public celebration — a movement fueled by dynamic ideals that never run dry.   

​

Liberty 250 is for anyone who:

 

  • Wants to live with purpose, courage, and clarity in a distracted world.

 

  • Believes the U.S. still has much to offer.

 

  • Leads a business, team, classroom, or family and wants to do it with principle.

 

  • Has felt disillusioned by politics but inspired by our founding ideals.

 

  • Believes legacy isn’t just what you leave behind—it’s how you live now.

Who It’s For

  • Books that unpack the essential traits of personal and organizational greatness.

​

  • Media and Storytelling designed to stir hearts and bring about change.

​

  • Workshops and Keynotes for companies, schools, churches, and communities. (COMING SOON)

​

  • Civic Engagement through the Liberty 250 Challenge, curriculum, and events. (COMING SOON)

​

  • The Liberty 250 Awards, honoring veterans, educators, entrepreneurs, and everyday patriots who embody the movement’s values. (COMING SOON)

How We Do It

  • Reconnect people with the values that shaped our noble nation.

 

  • Revive purposeful leadership across institutions large and small.

 

  • Rebuild trust in our shared heritage, common dreams, and mutual goals.  

 

  • Recognize individuals who live out these traits in courageous ways.

 

  • Reignite the American spirit with substance, service, and stories.

What We Do

United Traits of America

As America approaches its Semiquincentennial (250th birthday), United Traits of America is both a loving tribute and a call to action. Presented by Michael A. Graham, founder of the Liberty 250 movement and a Colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve, this book is a history lesson, self-improvement guide, and celebration—showcasing sundry values that define the spirit of freedom. Leveraging his leadership work in the Army and as an attorney, Graham explores the principles that crafted our country, keep it strong, and stand to reshape you.

— Gifts from our collective past to supercharge your present —

Inside, you’ll discover:

  • Fifty stories of gumption, grit, and grandeur

  • Hundreds of reasons to thank your lucky stars (and stripes) today

  • How core American tenets translate to personal and business triumphs

  • Simple ways to better serve your country, kin, and co-workers 

  • Inspiration to get involved in penning our next chapter

About Michael A. Graham

Michael A. Graham is a long-time soldier in the United States Army Reserve, a veteran of two combat deployments, and a nationally respected attorney and business leader based in Columbia, South Carolina. With a career that bridges law, military leadership, and entrepreneurial enterprise, Graham is known for his principled approach to life, service, and strategic growth.

​

Currently serving as commander of a unit in the Army Reserve Legal Command, he holds the rank of Colonel and has spent over twenty-seven years in uniform. He began his military journey as a helicopter repair specialist stationed in Europe before earning a direct commission into the Judge Advocate General’s Corps.

 

His assignments have included deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, as well as senior legal leadership roles at Fort Bragg, the Pentagon, and within NATO-supported operations. His military education includes the Command and General Staff College and U.S. Army War College, where he earned a Master of Strategic Studies. In the civilian sphere, Graham is a founding partner of D’Alberto, Graham & Grimsley, LLC and president of Overbrook Title Company, where he advises businesses and financial institutions on complex legal matters. 

​

His AV Preeminent rating by Martindale-Hubbell affirms his standing in the legal community, and his past roles include executive leadership at a multi-state firm and service as a prosecutor.

​

Driven by a passion for purposeful living and leadership, Graham is also the founder of Liberty 250, a national movement established to commemorate America’s Semiquincentennial by reigniting the core traits that built the nation: courage, service, innovation, gravitas, and integrity. Through books, keynotes, and civic initiatives, Liberty 250 inspires individuals and organizations to lead with clarity and conviction.

​

A graduate of the University of South Carolina, Troy State University, and Campbell University School of Law, Graham is also a private pilot and lifelong student of faith, history, and human potential. Whether mentoring young professionals, guiding corporate leaders, or commanding soldiers, he remains grounded in his core belief: liberty is a gift, and a responsibility.
